source: NASA Life Sciences Portal, experiment MR085G, WinSCAT, Flight Analogs bed-rest Campaigns 1 and 3
method: Running-memory response speed (1000 / CPTRT). Own usual = mean of the last three sessions before bed rest. Later sessions (during and after bed rest) are expressed as percent change from own usual. Intervals are 95% percentile bootstrap intervals, resampling whole people.

ares.source: LSDA Bed Rest Standard Measures, ARES simple reaction time, one volunteer (DOI 10.83263/7081-d617)
